title: Waffar
subtitle: Your smart saving assistant — tell me what you need, and I'll find the best fit at the best price, with the evidence to back it.
aiDisclosure: Waffar is an AI shopping assistant — it suggests based on prices we observed.
neutralityNote: Ranking is fully neutral — commercial interest never enters the ranking.
placeholder: e.g. a quiet, energy-saving AC for a 30 m² room under 4000 SAR
removeConstraintHint: Tap × to remove anything we misread
noResultsTitle: No verified products for this category yet
noResultsBody: We add categories only when real, trustworthy data exists — we never fabricate results. Try another category or wording.
notSupportedTitle: No specialized advisor for this category yet
notSupportedBody: We show the best trustworthy prices without a specialized pick — we never fabricate a rating we can't evidence.
errorBody: Describe the product you want clearly — e.g. "a gaming laptop under 5000" or "a large family dishwasher".
addRoomSize: Add the room size (in m²) so I can size the capacity precisely.
measuredExitNote: Prices are from our observations; tapping takes you straight to the store.
evidenceIntro: We show what this recommendation is built on — clearly separating what is verified, what is inferred, and what is unknown.
evidenceFactsHint: Information we actually observed from stores.
evidenceInferencesHint: Conclusions computed from facts, not directly observed numbers.
evidenceUnknownHint: Data we don't have — we say so rather than fabricate it.
cheaperNotBetter: Cheaper isn't always better: we rank by suitability, total cost and trust — not price alone.
